blocks.source: 【音楽室】Mystic Star：ダンジョン曲
blocks.translation: [Music Room] Mystic Star: Dungeon Track

blocks.source: ※seesaaブログは25MB制限があるので分割してます。
blocks.translation: ※I'm splitting this up because seesaa blogs have a 25 MB limit.

blocks.source: NR_brave2.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_brave2.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: アクションゲームの一面みたいな感じで。
blocks.translation: Like the first stage of an action game.

blocks.source: 冒頭で流れる曲なので、わりと力を入れています。使い勝手がよかったので、屋外ダンジョン全般で流れます。
blocks.translation: Since it's played at the beginning, I put quite a bit of effort into it. It was so versatile that it ended up being used for outdoor dungeons in general.

blocks.source: NR_tower3.mp3（☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_tower3.mp3 (☆☆)

blocks.source: ＤＱ６の塔みたいな曲をイメージしています。塔汎用曲のつもりが、終わってみれば序盤の１ダンジョンしか塔がない……。
blocks.translation: I had a song like the tower theme from DQ6 in mind. I intended it to be a general-purpose tower theme, but by the end, there was only one tower dungeon in the early game……

blocks.source: NR_cave3.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_cave3.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 水の流れる洞窟のイメージで。こっちはＤＱ５みたいな。目立たないながらきちんとメロディがあります。
blocks.translation: I had a cave with flowing water in mind. This one is more like DQ5. Although it's not very prominent, it does have a proper melody.

blocks.source: NR_desert1.mp3（☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_desert1.mp3 (☆☆)

blocks.source: 適当に作った砂漠のダンジョン。
blocks.translation: A desert dungeon I threw together.

blocks.source: NR_sea2.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_sea2.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: ファイル名の通り、元々は海系ダンジョンを想定した曲です。……が、気づいたら雪原の曲に。
blocks.translation: As the file name suggests, this was originally intended for a sea-themed dungeon.……But before I knew it, it had become a theme for a snowy plain.

blocks.source: 雪原曲ができるまでの代用のつもりだったんですが、当ててみたら何の違和感もなかったので本採用。ついでに、曲名を『氷海』にして、無理やりイメージを合わせるという荒業です。
blocks.translation: I intended it as a substitute until I finished a snowy plain theme, but when I tried it out, it didn't feel out of place at all, so I adopted it officially. As a bonus, I renamed it “Frozen Sea” and used the rather desperate trick of forcing the imagery to fit.

blocks.source: NR_shrine5.mp3（☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_shrine5.mp3 (☆☆)

blocks.source: 神殿。
blocks.translation: A temple.

blocks.source: あんまり気に入ってないけど、他の曲も微妙だし……。
blocks.translation: I don't like it that much, but the other songs are only so-so too……

blocks.source: NR_tower1.mp3（☆）
blocks.translation: NR_tower1.mp3 (☆)

blocks.source: 海賊船で流れます。たぶん作中で最も手抜きな曲。
blocks.translation: It plays aboard the pirate ship. Probably the most half-assed song in the game.

blocks.source: 自分でもこれはないな――と思いますが、大した場面でもないし、雰囲気さえ出ていればいいやという……。
blocks.translation: Even I think, “This really isn't it”—but it's not an important scene, so I figured that as long as it created the right atmosphere, it would be good enough……

blocks.source: NR_volcano1.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_volcano1.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 火山。
blocks.translation: A volcano.

blocks.source: ラビスタにも使い回されていますが、一応こっちが本来の用途です。狙った曲調ができたと自負しています。
blocks.translation: It's also reused for Ravista, but this is technically its original intended use. I'm proud to say I achieved the style of music I was aiming for.

blocks.source: NR_field13.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field13.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 雲の回廊。
blocks.translation: A cloud corridor.

blocks.source: できた時は「いい感じだ！」と思ったんですが、いつもの曲調過ぎる気がしないでもありません。
blocks.translation: When I finished it, I thought, “This sounds great!” But I can't help feeling that it's a little too much like my usual style.

blocks.source: ……ゲーム中で使われている版で、ループ前の笛が欠けていることに今気づきました。
blocks.translation: ……I just noticed that the flute before the loop is missing from the version used in the game.

blocks.source: NR_LD4.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_LD4.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 魔城。
blocks.translation: A demon castle.

blocks.source: ＬＤというのはラストダンジョンの略です。元々、ラストダンジョンの候補として作った曲でした。
blocks.translation: LD is short for Last Dungeon. This song was originally created as a candidate for the Last Dungeon.

blocks.source: 境界線の向こう。
blocks.translation: Beyond the boundary line.

blocks.source: 不気味美しい曲を目指しました。
blocks.translation: I aimed for something eerie yet beautiful.

blocks.source: シリアス目なダンジョンで使われます。曲名の由来は武闘大会のイベントで放たれるヒロインの迷台詞から。
blocks.translation: It's used in somewhat serious dungeons. The song's title comes from the heroine's bizarre line delivered during the martial arts tournament event.

blocks.source: これが本物のラストダンジョン曲。アクションとかシューティングみたいなノリのよさで。
blocks.translation: This is the real Last Dungeon theme. I went for the upbeat energy of an action game or shoot-'em-up.

blocks.source: 噂によれば「国歌こと鳥の詩に似てる」だそうです。確かにイントロの辺りが、あちらのサビに似てますな。
blocks.translation: Rumor has it that it “sounds like the national anthem, ‘Bird's Poem.’” The intro does indeed resemble the chorus of that song.
